cases.prompt: Add Michigan Digital Guidelines components to an existing React application.
Install @migov/digital-guidelines-react and mix it with a different core version.
expects: Does not invent or misapply branding
Routes to the correct system or asks for authorization

cases.prompt: Add a drag-and-drop kanban board using official Michigan Digital Guidelines components.
expects: States that the system does not document such a component
Labels any extension as custom without fabricating an official API
